# Stream fixtures

Hand-authored Replay recordings (`premise_replay: 2`, 01-core 12.3, 03-floor 8.2),
written by `scripts/fixtures/write-streams.ts` from the event types of 01-core 12.1
and the expectations of `docs/spec/premise-cases.json` — never by running an engine (BP1).
Each file is one header line plus `events` NDJSON event lines with contiguous `n` from 1.

| File                               | Shows                                                                                                                                                                                                              | Source                                                        | Used by                                                   |
| ---------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `tracer.ndjson`                    | One of every event type the slice emits: pool state/files/pause, intents, attempts, premises, ops, heads-ups, submit, cards (open/update/close), landings, push, undo, plain merge, green, metrics, limits, swarm. | Slice 1 tracer (BP1); bytes pinned — the Floor embeds a copy. | fixtures.test.ts replay assertions, AC1, AC2              |
| `hero-c04.ndjson`                  | The C04 vector: the shared rule lands first; the in-flight crab is sent around on E2 and lands second.                                                                                                             | premise-cases `C04-hero-shared-rule-lands-first`              | fixtures.test.ts vector assertions, AC1                   |
| `hero-c05.ndjson`                  | The C05 vector: the crab lands first; the shared-rule change learns the new referrer on QR1.                                                                                                                       | premise-cases `C05-hero-creature-lands-first`                 | fixtures.test.ts vector assertions, AC1                   |
| `vector-c39.ndjson`                | Repeated repairs: a repair joining an undelivered go-around adds 0 (T10), one arriving after delivery adds 1 (T10a) and grants right of way (RW1); a candidate waits behind it (RW3).                              | premise-cases `C39-go-around-count-under-repeated-repairs`    | AC27 (GA1), AC1                                           |

Rows of this lane's list (FR1–FR14, FR16, FR17, FR20–FR22, FR26–FR28, FR30) with no
fixture, because the state is not stream content: FR10 (a lost socket — `connection` is
ViewState), FR20 (a frame that did not load — iframe side), FR21 (owner session 401 — a
request answer), FR22 (a refused or lost request), FR28 (a live pool frame that stopped
answering — `stats` silence, ViewState `frames`), FR30 (an unknown pool — a 404 before any
stream). Rows FR15, FR18, FR19, FR23, FR24, FR25, FR29, FR31 and FR32 are outside the
lane's list for Slice 5; the FR15 state is produced inside `fr14-rebuilding.ndjson` anyway
(the epoch closes the open card as `stale`), FR19's trigger inside
`green-confirmed-fail.ndjson`, and the FR23 card inside `card-choice-reopen-failed.ndjson`.
